text:
Predicates:
Flu(x) ::: x is a person who gets the flu.
Premises:
∀x (MonkeypoxVirus(x) → InfectiousDisease(x)) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease caused by the monkeypox virus.
Animal(x) ∧ Includes(x, MonkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Humans(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(x) ∧ Animal(x) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(x, fever) ∧ Symptom(x, headache) ∧ Symptom(x, musclePains) ∧ Symptom(x, tiredness) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
FeelingTired(x) ∧ Gets(x, glu) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Gets(x, flu)) ::: No one gets the flu.
